title: Akeekkachiisa Xiqqoo Keessummeessituu Hiriiraa Dura
intro: Gammoojjii bulchaan jabaa fi keessummeessitoonni bal’aan itti dhiyaatanitti tarkaanfadhaa, imaltuu xiqqaan tokko akeekkachiisa hawaasa guutuu baraaru yeroo kennu fakkeessi. Hawaasni balaadhaaf saaxilame gaaddisa ga'een balaan sun darba. Akeekkachiisa sana duuba nama bira darbame adda baasuuf ragaalee hordofi.
clues: Ani uumamtoota xixiqqoo mootummaa bulchaa tokkoo wajjin walqabatan keessaa tokkodha.
Hawaasni koo mana jireenyaa gammoojjii keessa jiraatu, bakka tokkoon keenya warra kaan bilbiluu dandeenyu.
Bulchaa sanaa fi waraana bulchaa sana waliin imalu irraa doorsisni nu mudata.
Hawaasni koo akka mana jireenyaa isaanii seenuuf waamee osoo hin beekin akka hin caccabsinee nu akeekkachiisu ana.
Bulchaan Sulaymaan yoo ta’u, gosti koos uumamtoota ajaja isaa jala kaa’aman keessaa tokkodha.
Ani saree gammoojjii sanaa ti; akeekkachiisa koo booda mana jireenyaa keenya seennee, osoo akkas ta’ee osoo hin beekin nu qabee caccabsuu jalaa miliqne.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Hawaasni erga gaaddisa fudhatee booda baraarameera
Hawaasni osoo gaaddisa hin fudhatiin diigame
Sababa waraanni duubatti deebi'eef hawaasni hafe
Hawaasni kun simbirroota kana to'achuudhaan badhaafameera
Hawaasni kun booji'amee gara mana mootummaatti geeffame
outcome.answer: Hawaasni erga gaaddisa fudhatee booda baraarameera

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
